name: Vektro
description: A Vulshok mage who transfers his mind into Lyese's body and works for Memnarch.

description_citations.text: "The Fifth Dawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raksha's leonin ambush Vektro's goblin party and Geth's severed head delivers Yert's demand for Glissa.
timeline.quote: His animate head delivers a message from Yert

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "Geth's head". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raksha reveals that Vektro had transferred his mind into Lyese and Lyese was dead years earlier.
timeline.quote: Lyese revealed herself to be Vektro, having transferred minds into the elf girl.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The Leveler War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lyese/Vektro kills Yshkar; Dwugget wounds the impostor, Vektro flees, and Bruenna heals Lyese and teleports the mana bomb into the nim army.
timeline.quote: but Lyese/Vektro runs him through with a sword.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The Leveler War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Memnarch emerges cleansed, destroys Vektro, takes the Miracore, and reveals his ascension web.
timeline.quote: Judging Vektro a failed experiment, he destroys Vektro and takes the Miracore.

citation.text: "The Fifth Dawn", section "The Vanishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
